name: ModelVariant680Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant680us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (blooms of shaded petals open at model joints and release rings that fly out along a cone, bursts that flash and shoot five spokes, and rows of sparks shed from further joints); for a non-negative request it clears the work area, prints its size, packs eleven texture images and seeds the blooms, rings, bursts, sparks and delay from the command row indexed by the request; every call then counts down the delay or runs one frame, returning 1 once at frame 223, 4 while a burst is active before that, 2 once every element is inactive after frame 301 and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-697 and 764 images build it from the same source and bind its data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
